note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Screens that mix a terminal and a portal carry the second half in also[] (when = before/after the main part). Scenes read MG_LAB_ADMIN_UPN / MG_LAB_DOMAIN (set by prepare, derived from the signed-in labadmin).
prepare: Connect-MgGraph -Scopes Community.ReadWrite.All, Community.Read.All, EngagementRole.Read.All, Group.ReadWrite.All, Group.Read.All, User.ReadBasic.All -NoWelcome  # owner signs in (browser)
(Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri /v1.0/employeeExperience/roles).value | Select-Object displayName   # note the exact Engage role names in the README (the audit matches 'Network Admin')
# the native-mode check cannot be scripted: if the Engage network is not native the communities API fails here and the episode stops
try { Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri /v1.0/employeeExperience/communities | Out-Null } catch { throw "Communities API refused (network not in native mode, or consent missing): $($_.Exception.Message)" }

screens.name: apply

steps: Viva Engage on the web: the three new communities in the sidebar
Open one community: owners and members (the creator labadmin is also an owner)
mask: community and network ids in the address bar

screens.note: Creating takes 31+ seconds per community (polling): do not cut it. The runner signs in as labadmin interactively on the first call (owner signs in).

screens.name: audit
prepare: # off camera: make the tenant look like a real quarter. Through the community groups; if Graph refuses, do it in the Viva Engage UI
$gq = { param($n) (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/groups?`$filter=displayName eq '$n'").value[0].id }; $falcon = & $gq 'Project Falcon - Launch'; $ask = & $gq 'Contoso Ask Anything'

# NoOwner on 'Falcon Customer Stories' only if Engage allows it; jordan.demo as Network Administrator is done by hand in the Engage admin center (admins); set settings.maxNetworkAdmins to 2 in communities.lab.json for TooManyNetworkAdmins

steps: Open the report in the editor: code ./viva-audit.md
Scroll the findings table; mask UPNs

screens.name: teams
steps: Teams: open the Viva Engage app: the community list shows the communities the script created
Open the Viva Connections app only if the tenant already has a home site: show the dashboard as it is; do not set it up and do not open any Copilot feature (no licence)
If Viva Connections is not available, record Engage only and say so

teardown: foreach ($nm in 'Project Falcon - Launch', 'Contoso Ask Anything', 'Falcon Customer Stories') { foreach ($g in (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/groups?`$filter=displayName eq '$nm'").value) { Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method DELETE -Uri "/v1.0/groups/$($g.id)" } }   # deletes the three communities' Microsoft 365 groups; never run this for communities that existed before the recording
# by hand: remove jordan.demo as Network Administrator (Engage admin center); clear the browser profiles' sign-ins
needs: viva-engage:network in native mode (stop and tell the lead otherwise)
manual:jordan.demo as Network Administrator for the audit screen
